description: This C# source file defines the internal class 'RelationalStorage' which implements database interaction logic using ADO.NET. It provides methods for executing SQL queries, reading data asynchronously, handling command cancellation, and managing database connections. The class is designed to work with various database providers via invariant names, supporting operations like SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE with parameterized commands.

classes.name: RelationalStorage
classes.description: A general-purpose class to work with relational databases using ADO.NET, supporting asynchronous operations, command interception, and cancellation.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of IRelationalStorage with specified invariant name and connection string.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Executes a SELECT query asynchronously and maps the results using a selector function.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Executes a non-SELECT SQL command asynchronously (e.g., INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) and returns the rows affected.

methods.name: SelectAsync
methods.description: Helper method to process data reader results into a collection asynchronously.

methods.name: ExecuteReaderAsync
methods.description: Executes a DbCommand to read data asynchronously, supporting cancellation tokens.

methods.name: CommandCancellation
methods.description: Supports cancellation of ongoing database commands, calling Cancel on the DbCommand if supported.
